solo.name: enough stock succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: enough stock succeeds
call: purchase(db, product_id=1, qty=3)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT stock FROM products WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT -> [(5,)]
step 3   R1  UPDATE products SET stock = 2 WHERE id = 1 -> UPDATE 1
step 4   R1  INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) VALUES (1, 3) -> INSERT 0 1
step 5   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: stock never negative
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT p.stock = 2 AND o.n = 1 AND o.total = 3 FROM products p, (SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(qty) AS total FROM orders WHERE product_id = 1) o WHERE p.id = 1

solo.name: buying exactly the remaining stock succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: buying exactly the remaining stock succeeds
call: purchase(db, product_id=1, qty=3)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT stock FROM products WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT -> [(3,)]
step 3   R1  UPDATE products SET stock = 0 WHERE id = 1 -> UPDATE 1
step 4   R1  INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) VALUES (1, 3) -> INSERT 0 1
step 5   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: stock never negative
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT stock = 0 AND (SELECT count(*) = 1 FROM orders) FROM products WHERE id = 1

solo.name: not enough stock is refused cleanly
solo.trace:
solo check: not enough stock is refused cleanly
call: purchase(db, product_id=1, qty=3)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT stock FROM products WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT -> [(2,)]
step 3   R1  ROLLBACK -> ROLLBACK
         R1  returned False
invariant ok: stock never negative
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT stock = 2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders) FROM products WHERE id = 1

counterexamples:
scenario: two buyers, both fit
R1: purchase(db, product_id=1, qty=3)
R2: purchase(db, product_id=1, qty=3)
schedule choices: [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0]
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT stock FROM products WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT -> [(6,)]
step 3   R1  UPDATE products SET stock = 3 WHERE id = 1 -> UPDATE 1
step 4   R1  INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) VALUES (1, 3) -> INSERT 0 1
step 5   R2  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 6   R2  SELECT stock FROM products WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT -> ERROR 55P03 LockNotAvailable: could not obtain lock on row in relation "products"
step 7   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
step 8   R2  ROLLBACK -> ROLLBACK
         R2  returned False
invariant ok: stock never negative
invariant ok: stock is conserved (started at 6)
reproduced on re-run: True
